title: Real Product Spine, Persistence & Convergence Cutover
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-23 owner direction to plan/set up the family that takes Android + Windows to the real Multiversal app and two-person play.

selection_basis.reason: Installed BIP artifact proved the packaged client was still a synthetic alpha/fixture shell; owner authorized a real-product convergence family.

objective: Installed Android and Windows clients boot into the real Multiversal shell, use real persisted local identity/profile/state, load the governed Library/corpus, and no longer expose synthetic local-alpha fixtures as ordinary product data. A live-source convergence ledger classifies every user-facing implementation as integrated, stranded, internal-only, fixture/test-only, or intentionally deferred.
acceptance: Production App entry no longer defaults to LocalAlphaIdentityAdapter, synthetic fixture campaigns/characters, or diagnostic-first navigation.

packages/local-store (or an architecture-conforming replacement at the approved boundary) contains a real durable local implementation using the canonical application-data location and SQLite/local persistence rules.
Real profile/identity, selected context, app preferences, and resumable Home state survive process/device restart.

The actual packaged Library/corpus and provenance support load successfully on Android and Windows, or a concrete missing packaged dependency is repaired rather than hidden behind a generic unavailable state.
The production shell consumes current UI-convergence + UI-system/skin work and presents mobile/desktop layouts without alpha/debug labels.
A machine-readable convergence ledger covers all current live user-facing source families, including post-Bible additions; no later feature is silently dropped.
Publish the current-engine Asset Demand Ledger covering required art/audio/3D/specialty media and its primary/generated/imported/fallback/unresolved strategy.
Record primary-art dependencies and parameter/variation dimensions so PCV-02 can implement the onboard pixel generator without inventing a one-off asset corpus.
boundaries: Old UI/Screen/Feature Bibles are floor/reference only and may not erase later implemented features.
Current live repository, newer convergence/UI-skin decisions and current Development Bible architecture govern implementation reality.
PCV-01 must perform a real product cutover; a documentation-only inventory is insufficient.
Synthetic/local-alpha fixtures may remain for tests/dev harnesses but may not remain the ordinary packaged product path.
Do not activate paid/public/store/commercial provider scope merely to satisfy PCV-01.
PCV-02+ remain unauthorized until PCV-01 closes and successor selection occurs.
PCV-01 inventories and classifies asset demand but does not prematurely implement the PCV-02 onboard pixel generator.
next_action: PCV-01 is completed_verified. PCV-02 is the strict successor and is selected_not_started; await owner Continue before PCV-02 implementation.
